versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the huawei-cloud-cdn-universal-query skill.
- Provides comprehensive reference for all 44 GET (read-only) Huawei Cloud CDN APIs via hcloud CLI.
- Offers command templates, parameter guidance, and troubleshooting notes organized by functional categories (domain management, statistics, refresh/log/export, templates/rules/tags/account).
- Strictly read-only: all write/modify/delete (POST/PUT/DELETE) operations are prohibited and refused, with guidance to use the CDN console for such actions.
- Designed as a fallback skill when scenario-specific CDN query skills are not applicable.
